notes.title: Fan Art Contest Results
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35411862/f476c95e93791fb727b0ece70cc2c4c870f783fd.png[/img]

 [h3]Our In Blood Kickstarter ended with our first stretch goal exceeded[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35411862/49c24847fb9db20ff5965d163331bf8f8c36c2a0.png[/img]
[h3]Thank you so much for all your support, In Blood is gonna become a reality because of you! [/h3]

We're hard at work on the script atm, while waiting for funds to clear. You can follow us along on our process on [url=https://twitter.com/WafflesRtheBest]Jaime's twitter[/url].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35411862/08b5b5d69556bf51c9715db0e2bf9e21d58717ca.png[/img]

Our Fan Art contest has concluded and we got so many amazing art pieces! Thank you so much to everyone who sent us a submission, you made it really hard to choose!

[h2][url=https://jaimescribblesgames.com/2020/08/15/fan-art-contest-results/]You can see all the entries HERE[/url][/h2]

Or on the respective Steam community hubs.


With no further ado, our winner is..


*drum roll*


**


 [b]Ray by Vox Vulpi![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35411862/53adfad13217d1f6d5b3009dd1c816c726746e75.jpg[/img]

This image had so much depth and hidden meaning to it. We really liked how the artist incorporated flower language into the drawing, a fun detail from the game.

Vox Vulpi wins deluxe editions of all Jaime Scribbles Games, including In Blood when it releases.

We also want to reward each of the other entries with their own little reward. Check the blog post for more info.


Thank you so much again to everyone who participated!

notes.title: Fan Art Contest and In Blood Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[h2]July 1st In Blood launched on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/scribble-games/in-blood-a-visual-novel-game?ref=8x3o1d]Kickstarter![/url][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32662009/da3a19a6a5a138075d6ba48acf5f1bf3f8c811d7.png[/img]
Gothic romance meets Lovecraftian horror in this alternate dimension otome. 
Ellie's only way out is to ally with one of the four alluring monsters living there. But can they be trusted?

[h3]Along with the Kickstarter, we're running a fan art contest for [i]all[/i] of Jaime Scribbles Games ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/710950/Pinewood_Island/]Pinewood Island[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/806490/As_We_Know_It/]As We Know It[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116750/In_Blood/]In Blood[/url])[/h3] 
[h3]right here on Steam![/h3]
We'd love to see your art of our characters, no art exp needed! Existing Fan Art ok!

Just upload the Fan Art to Steam, Email us, or DM us on twitter to enter! ([url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/scribble-games/in-blood-a-visual-novel-game/posts/2883359][b]FULL DETAILS HERE![/b][/url])

[b]Win some AMAZING prizes![/b]

Stickers
Steam Keys
Wallpapers
Art Books
And more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32662009/442441334e6c02e0a6997a9acbdfdeccd41e48e0.png[/img]

[h3]The Rules:[/h3]
[list]
[*] It must be fan art from one of the above 3 games
[*] It must be uploaded to the game's steam page under 'Artwork' OR sent to us through email/twitter
[*] You must email/DM us so I know how to contact you and credit you.
[*] It does NOT have to be brand new fan art. If you've drawn fan art previously but have not uploaded it to steam, go ahead and submit!
[*] Multiple submissions are accepted, but will not increase your chance of winning.
[*] You can share and post the image wherever you like, We do not own any rights to your drawing. We only ask to post it on Twitter/Instagram and we would like to credit you. We're happy to post anonymously if requested as well. We can also post it to Steam for you, with your permission and upon request.
[/list]

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/scribble-games/in-blood-a-visual-novel-game/posts/2883359]More details in Kickstarter post![/url][/h1]

notes.title: In Blood Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30758643/6776b64bb40e7e8321a33cd64504d890bb7b64a0.png[/img]

[h1][b]In Blood[/b], the next game from Jaime Scribbles Games, now has a free demo available![/h1]

[h2]Get it on Steam by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116750/In_Blood/]Clicking Here[/url]!

You can find linux and mac builds by [url=https://scribbles.itch.io/inblood]Clicking Here[/url]![/h2]

In Blood is a dark fantasy/horror/romance otome/visual novel game. Ellie (accidentally!!) makes a blood pact with an ancient god and ends up trapped in another dimension full of monsters. She must try to escape while staying alive and maintaining her humanity, can she find someone she can trust to help her? 

* 4 romance options (3 male, 1 female)
* Choices that effect over 12 possible endings, including "dead ends"
* Full english voice acting
* Unlockable illustrations and achievements
* Overall gorgeous artwork
* Original music and immersive sfx
* Kickstarter coming in July
